en: A black-and-white landscape view of a valley with two hilltop fortifications on opposite sides. On the left stands a ruined medieval castle with one mostly intact round tower and another partially collapsed tower, both sitting atop a rocky ridge. On the right, across the valley, is a more preserved castle complex with a tall, pointed-roof tower and surrounding walls, also on a steep hill. The valley between is cultivated farmland with a light-colored strip of crop curving through the fields, bordered by trees and shrubs in the foreground. The sky area appears overexposed or cut out in the print. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
